description: Find duplicate references by matching DOI, by the same cite key, and by similar titles (the years must not clash). Each group says which entry to keep, the one with the most fields, and which to remove. Also returns the list as BibTeX with the extra copies dropped. Example: two entries with the same DOI, one with 3 fields and one with 6, give one group that keeps the entry with 6 fields and lists the other under remove. Your files are not changed.

format.description: The format of the text. Defaults to auto, which looks at the text to decide.

text.description: The reference list as text: BibTeX, RIS or CSL JSON.

title_threshold.description: How alike two titles must be to count as the same, from 0.5 to 1. Defaults to 0.9.

name: dedupe_entries

deduplicated_bibtex.description: The list as BibTeX without the removed copies.

unique.description: How many entries are left once the duplicates are dropped.

title: Find duplicate entries
